description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for ExpenseEntity in a Room database within an Android application. It provides methods for inserting or updating expenses, retrieving all expenses, and deleting all expenses.

classes.name: ExpenseDao
classes.description: Data Access Object interface for ExpenseEntity, providing methods to interact with expenses stored in the database.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Inserts a new expense or replaces an existing one with the same primary key. Returns the row ID of the inserted expense.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all expenses ordered by timestamp in descending order, returning a Flow that emits lists of ExpenseEntity objects.

methods.name: clearAll
methods.description: Deletes all expense records from the database.
